scope: 32 design states semantic audit, not 32 distinct required gestures; accepted inventory currently 32 packages.

states.label: 待命
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: closed quiet via actual closing; open neutral also truthful
states.guard: Do not infer idle from disconnect.

states.label: 接任务
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: opening + neutral attention; external observe shared fallback
states.guard: Do not replay welcome as task acceptance on a click alone.

states.label: 准备
states.guard: No speculative keyboard activity.

states.label: 思考
states.guard: Means generation, not private thoughts.

states.label: 输出交流
states.requiredFact: public text delta, currently not projected
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: shared observation until admitted public-output event
states.guard: Do not infer output from all generating.

states.label: 完成
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: completion once then neutral/closed quiet via lid bridge
states.guard: Do not replay on resync; new error/work request must supersede.

states.label: 阅读
states.guard: No private file content inferred.

states.label: 编辑
states.guard: Once activity ends, no indefinite typing.

states.label: 编程执行
states.guard: Long shell runtime is not continuous input or test success.

states.label: 浏览搜索
states.guard: Search completion not overall success.

states.label: 计算实验
states.requiredFact: explicit compute activity, currently no specialized classifier
states.guard: Do not label shell as training automatically.

states.label: 整理归档
states.guard: No arbitrary physical filing gesture required.

states.label: 检查验证
states.guard: Inspecting is not verified correctness.

states.label: 协作调度
states.requiredFact: active child activity or admitted retrieval category
states.guard: Parent completed must not hide active children or freeze celebration.

states.label: 排队
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: attentive screen wait; queue badge if known
states.guard: Queue does not override simultaneously executing work.

states.label: 等授权
states.guard: No expiry approval; denial no nod/success/resume.

states.label: 等回答
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: chin question→relaxed hold; actual answer→release→understood if warranted
states.guard: No timed answer or cancellation understanding nod.

states.label: 等外部
states.guard: Only label external cause when known.

states.label: 等重试
states.requiredFact: explicit retry scheduling, not currently projected
states.guard: Do not invent retryAt.

states.label: 失败
states.requiredFact: current run failed; operation failure scoped separately
states.guard: No looped surprise or success gesture.

states.label: 取消收尾
states.guard: Never equate request with executor stop.

states.label: 已停
states.requiredFact: independent scoped actual stop, unavailable in current projector
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: neutral round-cancelled presentation, not stopped declaration
states.guard: No need invent Host stop API; neutral exit remains available.

states.label: 断联未知
states.guard: Stop stale typing/celebration; retain unknown badge.

states.label: 重连同步
states.guard: Do not replay stale success or imply resumed execution.

states.label: 结果核查
states.guard: No auto retry, no generic failure equivalence.

states.label: 出场欢迎
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: peer-reviewed closed welcome, not yet in runtime inventory
states.guard: No replay on every Host update.

states.label: 呼吸眨眼
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: existing hold blink/posture inside current family
states.guard: Do not switch pose or change business state for blink.

states.label: 轻点回应
states.truthfulCurrentVisual: peer-reviewed closed click, not yet runtime inventory
states.guard: Tap is not task acceptance.

states.label: 提起拖动
states.guard: Until accepted use native reposition/neutral image, not fake carry contacts.

states.label: 落位整理
states.guard: No return-to-work action merely because landing ended.

states.label: 困倦伸展
states.guard: Do not stretch during permission, critical unknown or active typing.

states.label: 安静陪伴
states.guard: No selected branch must not assert connected idle work state.

remaining.requestedFix: Explicit neutral/disconnected fallback for synchronization, then current snapshot chooses activity; no old completion replay.

remaining.finding: welcome/click reviewed art exists but not installed runtime actions; relocation separately owned; C05/T05/W05 no dedicated facts
remaining.requestedFix: Wire only genuine local events/available facts, preserve neutral fallbacks. No additional big actions needed for counts.
